question: Which of the following diagram best depicts the relationship between A, B and C, where A means 'Colour of the leaves', B means 'Yellow coloured things' and C means 'Green coloured things'?
solution:
According to the given information, we have:

A = Colour of the leaves

B = Yellow coloured things

C = Green coloured things

So, we will have the Venn diagram as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88e9536b8b73fb7e6afceee434b6ac6b1671e259340ee329ec3fe8c9b0ae121f.png] 

The colour of some leaves can be yellow and some can be green.

Hence, the correct answer is '**option 1)**'.
